summary: Post-import smoke test of SMA Negeri 1 Laguboti school system. Backend: 99/99 pytest checks passed (settings, health, login success/fail, /auth/me, all 6 /api/cron/* return 401 without auth and with a wrong secret, and 87 authenticated GET list endpoints with no 5xx). Frontend: super admin login works and lands on the dashboard. I clicked all 38 sidebar menu items; every page rendered content (main innerText > 0) with no page errors or error boundaries. Public pages all load without login: /info-tamu, /ppdb (via 'Buka Formulir PPDB'), /struktur-organisasi, /galeri, /profil-sekolah (via 'Lihat Profil Sekolah'). I found no blocking issues.

minor.issue: Returns 422 when the 'month' query is missing. The frontend always sends it, so this is informational only.

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration warning). It does not break rendering; it most likely comes from the dev visual-edit wrapper, or from mixed text in <option> at Reports.jsx line 68 'Semester {s}'. Could use a template literal: {`Semester ${s}`}
TANGGAL LAHIR uses the browser's native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn calendar, and the mm/dd format is inconsistent with an Indonesian audience
Console shows 401 errors from the unauthenticated /api/auth/me probe. This is expected and harmless.

action_items: Optional: fix the <option> hydration warning in Reports.jsx
Optional: replace the native date input on the PPDB form with the shadcn Calendar/date picker
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 8389 lines. It should be split into routers per module (auth, attendance, cron, library, etc.).
The cron guard is done properly (hmac.compare_digest, idempotent run_id), but the guard logic in /cron/attendance-archive and /cron/kas-reminder is duplicated instead of reusing _cron_guard.
seed_data_creation: None. The DB is empty apart from the seeded super admin.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Super admin sees 38 sidebar links (aside nav a, data-testid nav-<label-kebab>). /presentasi has no DashboardLayout sidebar (standalone route), so go back after clicking it. Running all 38 clicks in one Playwright run times out, so batch them in groups of 12-18. Live class (LiveKit) could not be tested end-to-end because there are no classes and LIVEKIT_URL is empty; /pemantau-live opens fine.
